articles.title: Thailand bombs Cambodian border area as ceasefire talks continue
articles.summary: Thailand's air force launched strikes on a disputed border area with Cambodia on Friday. This military action occurred even as officials from both nations continued talks aimed at de-escalating the conflict. The Thai Air Force confirmed targeting Cambodian positions, highlighting ongoing tensions and a complex situation involving both military engagement and diplomatic efforts to resolve the long-standing border dispute.

articles.title: Acsia Technologies named among CII’s Top 50 Innovative Companies for 2025
articles.summary: Acsia Technologies, a global automotive software provider known for Digital Cockpits, e-Mobility, and Telematics, has been recognized among India's Top 50 Innovative Companies. Their innovative work strengthens India's position in the global tech landscape, highlighting their expertise in developing cutting-edge software for the automotive sector, crucial for future industry advancements and national technological prowess.

articles.title: North Korea Releases Photos of Submarine Equipped with Nuclear Engine for Extended Underwater Travel

articles.title: Thai defence minister to attend truce talks with Cambodia, PM says
articles.summary: Thailand's Defence Minister will join talks with Cambodia on Saturday to secure a truce following persistent border clashes between the two Southeast Asian nations. The Thai Premier emphasized diplomatic efforts to de-escalate tensions and foster regional stability. This significant engagement aims to resolve the longstanding conflict peacefully, showcasing a commitment to regional security.
